# eQOURSE

> eQOURSE is a global AI-data-services and content-services brand. Primary operations and delivery are led by EQOURSE ONLINE EDUCATIONERS LLP in Kota, India; EQOURSE PTE. LTD. is a separately registered Singapore entity supporting international business development, client engagement, partnerships and contracting where applicable. eQOURSE provides multilingual AI training datasets, annotation, validation, model testing, robotics training data and custom learning content.

## Primary service areas

- [Content Services](https://www.eqourse.com/content-services): E-learning, assessment, localization, technology, accessibility, talent, and publishing services.
- [AI Data Services](https://www.eqourse.com/ai-data-services): Data collection, annotation, cleaning, validation, model testing, and robotics data services.
- [AI Data Collection](https://www.eqourse.com/ai-data-services/data-collection): Multimodal data collection for production AI systems.
- [Text Data Collection](https://www.eqourse.com/ai-data-services/data-collection/text-data-collection): Text datasets for NLP, LLMs, and generative AI.
- [Audio and Speech Data Collection](https://www.eqourse.com/ai-data-services/data-collection/audio-data-collection): Multilingual speech and audio datasets.
- [Image Data Collection](https://www.eqourse.com/ai-data-services/data-collection/image-data-collection): Image datasets collected under real-world conditions.
- [Video Data Collection](https://www.eqourse.com/ai-data-services/data-collection/video-data-collection): Video datasets for computer vision and multimodal AI.
- [Robotics Training Data](https://www.eqourse.com/robotics-training-data-services): Human-demonstration, teleoperation, sensor, and embodied-AI data.
- [Human Demonstrations for Robotics](https://www.eqourse.com/robotics-training-data-services/human-demonstrations): Teleoperation, egocentric, and multi-view task demonstrations with failure-and-recovery episodes, synchronized signals, per-episode QA, and delivery in LeRobot, RLDS, or HDF5 formats.
- [Multimodal Sensor Data for Robotics](https://www.eqourse.com/robotics-training-data-services/multimodal-sensor-data): Time-synchronised vision, depth, proprioception, force-torque, tactile, IMU and audio with measured synchronisation error, calibration residuals and per-episode lineage.
- [3D & Spatial Annotation for Robot Manipulation](https://www.eqourse.com/robotics-training-data-services/3d-spatial-annotation): Task-conditioned grasp sets, affordance regions, 6-DoF object pose, articulation and simulation-ready assets, including verification of machine-generated candidates.
- [VLA Evaluation & Robot Policy Benchmarking](https://www.eqourse.com/robotics-training-data-services/vla-evaluation): Controlled real-robot policy evaluation with documented protocols, trial counts derived from the claim, failure taxonomy, recovery analysis, generalisation testing and same-fixture human baselines.
- [Robot Deployment Validation](https://www.eqourse.com/robotics-training-data-services/deployment-validation): Structured on-site observation against pre-agreed acceptance criteria, including endurance, intervention, near-miss and human-robot interaction evidence. eQOURSE supplies evidence; it does not certify safety or sign conformity assessments.

## Company and resources

- **Corporate structure:** One eQOURSE brand, with separately registered legal entities in India and Singapore. Neither should be described as the parent or subsidiary of the other. Engagement documents identify the applicable contracting entity.

- [About eQOURSE](https://www.eqourse.com/aboutus): Company background, capabilities, leadership, and locations.
- [Case Studies](https://www.eqourse.com/casestudy): Selected delivery outcomes.
- [Samples](https://www.eqourse.com/samples): Content and AI-data work samples.
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://www.eqourse.com/faq): Common questions about engagement and delivery.
- [Contact](https://www.eqourse.com/contact-us): Business enquiries.
- [Free Pilot](https://www.eqourse.com/free-pilot): Request a scoped pilot project.
